continuation_notes: No new accounts, tokens, paid APIs, quote/market-cap collection, source contacting or guessed URL enumeration.
Publisher date and metadata check time are separate; issuer PDF announcement date remains unverified until document review.
A removed link or failed request retains old metadata and never erases a verified dividend fact.
HTML-only issuer lists may miss script-rendered disclosures and pagination; latest revision is not guaranteed.
The default CLI audits this manifest offline. Explicit --fetch writes only the work checkpoint/review queue, never the static dividend fact seed.
